newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close steady in dull trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Tuesday in dull trading at the end of 1996, dealers at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.

The rates remained unchanged as textile mills, which are the main buyers, remained on the sidelines on the last day of 1996, and are likely to open steady on Wednesday, dealer Abdul Kadir Kashan said.
In the kerb market, the rate for the NIAB-78 variety fluctuated between 2,365 and 2,475 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), he said.
